lead.headline: Nothing broke overnight; the Coker claim is still the move
lead.deck: 2-5. The lineup is the projection lineup. No starter is designated; inactives at 10:30 CDMX.
lead.body: Start with what is still wrong. Jalen Coker, dropped by mistake on Wednesday, sits on Chem waivers until Wednesday 4 November at 02:00, and this brief cannot see whether the claim is in. Daron Payne, the Commanders D/ST's best lineman, is now reported out for the season — a weaker front, but nothing free beats the defence by a point, so it stays. No AVIATO starter is on any Week 8 injury list this morning; Allen is back from the bye in the week's highest total, Hockenson faces the league's softest defence against tight ends, and the lineup as set is the projection lineup. Glance at the inactives at 10:30 if you are up; otherwise leave it.
